entities.summary: Denis Platonov is a Russian former professional ice hockey centre who most notably played for Metallurg Magnitogorsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected by the Nashville Predators in the 3rd round of the 2001 NHL Entry Draft.
